error.title: An Error Occured: {{msg}}

underage: Your Apple ID may be below the required age to use developer services.
account_locked: Don't panic! This usually occurs after multiple failed login attempts, but it is completely harmless.
Go to ((link:https://iforgot.apple.com/)) to unlock your account.
auth: Make sure the credentials are correct and try again (even if you're sure they're correct).
Try using a different Apple ID if the issue persists.
Security key based two factor authentication is not supported. Use an Apple ID without 2FA or with trusted device verification instead.
download: Download SideStore manually from ((link:https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/releases)) and use the "Import IPA" button to install it instead.
house_arrest: [ios::26.3] Make sure you are not on iOS 26.3 beta, as there is a bug with house arrest on that version.
pairing: Try reconnecting your device and trying again.
Make sure your device has a passcode set.
Make sure your device is connected via USB, not Wi-Fi.
usbmuxd: [platform::windows] Make sure ((link:https://apple.co/ms:iTunes)) is installed and can see your device.
[platform::windows] Uninstall iTunes and Apple Mobile Device Support, then install "Apple Devices" from the Microsoft Store.
[platform::linux] Make sure the usbmuxd service is installed and running.
trust: Unlock your device, go to the home screen, and accept the "Trust This Computer" prompt if it appears.
device_coms: Make sure your device is properly connected to your computer.
Unplug and replug your device. Try a different USB port or cable if the issue persists.
not_logged_in: Please log in to your Apple ID first.
no_device_selected: Please select a device before proceeding.
anisette: Make sure your computer is connected to the internet.
Change the Anisette server. Try several different ones.
Check if ((link:{{anisetteServerUrl}})) opens in your browser.
keyring: Try enabling "Don't use keyring" in settings to bypass this issue. Note that this is less secure.
misc: Try again. Restarting the app, your computer, and/or your phone may also help.
admin: Try running the app with elevated permissions (as administrator/root).
filesystem: Make sure nyx.loader has permission to read and write files on your system.
not_enough_app_ids: You do not have enough App IDs available to install this app.
Wait for App IDs to expire after 7 days (cannot be deleted sooner), then try again.
Installing apps from SideStore sometimes allows you to use less App IDs, so try installing from there instead.
max_apps: You can only have 3 sideloaded apps installed at a time with a free Apple ID.
Delete other sideloaded apps to free up space for this one.
Expired apps still count towards the 3 app limit.

error.support_message: If the issue persists, press "Copy to clipboard" and send the copied error to <portal>nyx.sideload.space</portal> for support.
